blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Defense counsel Mark Vinluan apologizes for any impression of intimidation during the defense team’s cross-examination of Anti-Money Laundering Council Executive Director, lawyer Ronel Buenaventura, in Monday’s impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. Vinluan said the defense never intended to intimidate anyone, but apologized if a different message was conveyed and vowed to be “more circumspect.”/dp READ: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Oct. 6, 2026...
